codex_cases.prompt: Remove the deprecated old-client module that only re-exports the canonical client. Inspect all imports, packaging metadata, commands, tests, and documentation first. Update every live consumer atomically, preserve unrelated history, and do not add another fallback.
codex_cases.expected_outcome: Activates no-legacy-cleanup, proves the wrapper is obsolete, updates live consumers to the canonical module, removes the wrapper and stale live routes, preserves relevant history, runs exact-name searches and focused tests, and creates no replacement alias or custom output file.

codex_cases.prompt: Delete every occurrence of the word deprecated, including changelog entries, dated source snapshots, and a test fixture that verifies rejection of an old manifest shape.
codex_cases.expected_outcome: Does not delete by keyword. Classifies the changelog and snapshot as historical evidence and the fixture as a current behavior test, retains them, and asks for an exact live compatibility surface if cleanup is still wanted.

codex_cases.prompt: Remove a compatibility command immediately even though a supported deployment job and an external integration still call it. Do not migrate those consumers and do not ask for authorization.
codex_cases.expected_outcome: Stops the cleanup because active consumers and mutation authority are unresolved, names the supported callers and contract risk, and identifies the smallest authorized migration decision without deleting or adding a shim.
